steps.note: the upstream: an HTTP/2 server whose answer to HEAD is its HEADERS frame ending the stream (upstream c4e2b8985, the peer's image; ours alike)
forwarded over TLS, upgraded to HTTP/2 by forwardProxyHttp2Upgrade (the peer's host differs: the Docker bridge address when recording)
HEAD of a plain response: the upstream's content-length kept
HEAD of a response announcing trailers: the trailer header is not relayed
HEAD of an SSE response: aggregated, content-length 0
GET of the same: the trailer relayed as a header
GET of the SSE response: streamed
